stories.title: Flintshire council can’t say if recycling centre cuts saved £250,000
stories.summary: Flintshire Council cannot say whether cutting recycling centre opening hours saved the £250,000 it was supposed to, according to an internal audit. The audit gives the council’s management of household recycling centres and fly-tipping the lowest rating of “limited assurance”. It will go before the council’s environment and economy scrutiny committee on Tuesday (10 November).

stories.title: Greenfield Valley parkrun to welcome walkers for World Diabetes Day

stories.title: Parc Adfer carbon capture plant approved despite doubts over 95% claim
stories.summary: Plans to capture carbon dioxide from the Parc Adfer waste plant on Deeside Industrial Park have been approved by Flintshire councillors. Enfinium wants to build a carbon capture plant next to its energy recovery facility off Weighbridge Road.
